  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script (translated from PBS)

# PBS requested:
#   -l walltime=72:00:00
#   -l select=1:ncpus=24:mpiprocs=24:ngpus=4:powerai=on
#   -l place=scatter:excl
#   -N ResIm50E2
#   -j oe
#   -V
#   -q standard
#   -A MHPCC96650NRL

flux alloc \
  -N 1 \
  -n 24 \
  -c 1 \
  --gpus=4 \
  --time=72h \
  --queue=standard \
  bash -lc '

# NOTE: PBS -A MHPCC96650NRL (account/project) has no universally portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none for runtime, but accounting/charging/allocation association may be incorrect.

# NOTE: PBS place=scatter:excl has no universally portable Flux directive.
# Performance implication: without placement/exclusive controls, you may see different locality and potential
# contention with other jobs, affecting performance.

# NOTE: PBS powerai=on has no universally portable Flux directive.
# Performance implication: specialized software stack/hardware enablement may not be provided, potentially
# impacting performance or causing runtime failures.

# NOTE: PBS job name (-N ResIm50E2) has no universally portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none (metadata only).

# NOTE: PBS -V (export all environment variables) has no universally portable Flux directive.
# Performance implication: if your Flux submission environment does not already propagate needed variables,
# job behavior may differ.

# PBS -j oe (join stdout/stderr): approximate by redirecting stderr to stdout.
exec 2>&1

. /usr/share/Modules/init/sh
module load glog/0.3.3
module load gflags/2.2.0

export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$LD_LIBRARY_PATH:/gpfs/pkgs/mhpcc/protobuf/lib:/gpfs/pkgs/mhpcc/boost/lib:/gpfs/pkgs/mhpcc/lmdb/lib:/gpfs/pkgs/mhpcc/leveldb/lib:/gpfs/pkgs/mhpcc/opencv-3.4.0/lib64

cd /gpfs/scratch/lnsmith/deepLearning/caffe/9-11-17/

./examples/bk_imagenet/queues/resnet/b2train2.sh

# NOTE: This script submits another job with qsub. Under Flux this will not work unless PBS tools are present.
# Performance implication: downstream workflow submission will not happen.
qsub ./examples/bk_imagenet/queues/resnet/maqsub1.pbs

exit
'
"
}
